title: Deployment Decision Reliability: A Generalizability-Theory Framework for Sizing Long-Horizon Agent Evaluations
abstract: arXiv:2608.11323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise practitioners read agent leaderboards as if they ranked agent capability. We show, across three open agent-trace benchmarks (TheAgentCompany, $\tau^2$-bench, and AppWorld), that the agent main effect accounts for less than 3% of total variance in every dataset and check type, while the agent-by-task interaction accounts for 7-23%. Leaderboards rank specialization, not capability. We arrive at this through a four-facet Generalizability Theory variance decomposition, fit with three estimators (Henderson Method-I, REML via lme4, and a Bayesian binomial GLMM) that agree to three decimal places. Four further findings sharpen what the leaderboard is hiding. First, aggregate reliability collapses on the hardest task quartile: $E\rho^2$ on $\tau^2$ action_checks falls from 0.752 to 0.000. translated_title: 部署决策可靠性：用于确定长期智能体评估规模的一般化理论框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11323v1 公告类型：新 摘要：企业从业者阅读智能体排行榜，仿佛它们对智能体能力进行了排名。我们通过三个开放的智能体轨迹基准（TheAgentCompany、$\tau^2$-bench 和 AppWorld）证明，在每一个数据集和检查类型中，智能体主效应占总方差的比例不足3%，而智能体与任务交互效应占7-23%。排行榜排名的是专业化程度，而非能力。我们通过四方面一般化理论方差分解得出这一结论，该分解使用三种估计器（Henderson方法I、通过lme4的REML以及贝叶斯二项GLMM）拟合，结果一致到小数点后三位。另外四个发现进一步揭示了排行榜所隐藏的内容。首先，在最具挑战性的任务四分位数上，聚合可靠性崩溃：$\tau^2$ 上 action_checks 的 $E\rho^2$ 从0.752降至0.000。其次，训练单元可靠性与留出可靠性呈负相关（$\tau^2$ 上 $r = -0.90$），这意味着看似最可靠的设计实际上...
tldr: 本论文通过一般化理论方差分解证明智能体排行榜主要衡量任务特定专业化而非通用能力，并揭示其可靠性在困难任务上崩溃及训练与留出可靠性负相关等关键缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper uses Generalizability Theory variance decomposition to show that agent leaderboards primarily measure task-specific specialization rather than general capability, revealing critical flaws such as reliability collapse on hard tasks and negative correlation between training and held-out reliability.
